A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 34 readable pages, including Appendices A.1-A.13. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on synthetic classification tasks and CIFAR-10/CIFAR-2, including geometry evolution, generalization and feature/sample removal results in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the accuracy and geometry measurements in Figures 1-14 and the sample-removal comparisons in Tables 1-2.

M1.justification: The model components, training objectives and geometry-based feature removal and sample-scoring procedures are unchanged. The edits do not introduce or modify a method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic classification scenarios and CIFAR-10/CIFAR-2 tasks. No dataset, task, domain or evaluation scenario is added or removed, including in the appendices.

E2.justification: The evaluated architectures and random feature/sample removal baselines are unchanged. Figure 5(a)'s correction from LeNet to MLP matches its existing caption and does not establish a change in comparator membership.

E3.justification: The stated sampling procedures, metrics, model configurations and training settings in the experimental sections and Appendix A.12 are identical. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The label-randomization, isotropic-data, dataset-size and learning-rate analyses in Appendices A.4 and A.7-A.9 are unchanged, as are the feature and sample importance experiments.

E5.justification: Appendix A.12.2 retains five repetitions and 68% confidence intervals for Figures 4-6 and Tables 1-2, alongside mean-only reporting for Figures 2, 3 and 8. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All plotted results and numerical entries in Tables 1-2 remain unchanged, including the appendix results. Figure 5(a)'s corrected label resolves an inconsistency with its already-correct caption; its curves and reported findings are identical.

T1.justification: Definitions 2.1-2.2, Theorems 3.1-3.2, both conjectures and the appendix's propositions, derivations and proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same geometric invariance hypothesis, covariance-projection claims and contributions concerning generalization. The added code statement does not alter these scientific claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning geometry, generalization and simplicity bias are unchanged. Appendix A.13 retains the same theoretical approximations, small-scale experimental scope and applicability limitations.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code-availability statement and a link to the dr-faustus/GIH repository in the abstract. Appendix A.12's implementation information is unchanged; repository contents and functionality cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The reference list and related-work discussions in the introduction and Appendix A.1 are unchanged, including the positioning relative to neural anisotropy directions and the simplicity bias hypothesis.

P1.justification: v3 corrects MPLs to MLPs in the abstract and normalizatio to normalization in Figure 4's caption, adds the code-availability sentence and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Section organization and the remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 5(a) is relabeled from LeNet to MLP, making it consistent with the caption. The added abstract sentence slightly shifts the first-page layout; figure contents, table structures and appendix layouts otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 removes the misleading model label in Figure 5(a), corrects two typos and provides an explicit route to the paper's code. These modest improvements aid interpretation and code discoverability, while the scientific evidence, theory and limitations remain unchanged.
